Alabama county ECMWF S2S sm20 calibrated soil-moisture outlook

Forecast init: 2026-08-23. Periods: Week 1, Week 2, Week 3-4, Week 5-6. Reference: ERA5-Land county means; 20-year ECMWF reforecasts; weekly init dates pooled by season.

1. Key findings

  • Week 1: statewide mean P(SM<P20) = 51%; 33 of 67 counties have a probability of 50% or more; mean calibrated ensemble is -0.001 m3/m3 relative to P20.
  • Week 2: statewide mean P(SM<P20) = 46%; 28 of 67 counties have a probability of 50% or more; mean calibrated ensemble is +0.005 m3/m3 relative to P20.
  • Week 3-4: statewide mean P(SM<P20) = 43%; 29 of 67 counties have a probability of 50% or more; mean calibrated ensemble is +0.018 m3/m3 relative to P20.
  • Week 5-6: statewide mean P(SM<P20) = 32%; 0 of 67 counties have a probability of 50% or more; mean calibrated ensemble is +0.036 m3/m3 relative to P20.
  • Validation, Week 1: median calibrated ACC 0.90 (raw 0.89); median MSE skill vs climatology +0.80; calibration lowers RMSE in 97% of county-season fits.
  • Validation, Week 2: median calibrated ACC 0.74 (raw 0.73); median MSE skill vs climatology +0.55; calibration lowers RMSE in 98% of county-season fits.
  • Validation, Week 3-4: median calibrated ACC 0.48 (raw 0.45); median MSE skill vs climatology +0.21; calibration lowers RMSE in 98% of county-season fits.
  • Validation, Week 5-6: median calibrated ACC 0.34 (raw 0.29); median MSE skill vs climatology +0.09; calibration lowers RMSE in 97% of county-season fits.
  • Resolution: 43 of 67 counties draw at least 80% of their forecast from a single 1.5 deg S2S cell, so neighbouring counties share most of the forecast signal.

3. Leave-one-year-out validation

3b. Single-date vs seasonally pooled validation

Calibrated correlation from the single-date test (23 August, 20 years) compared with the seasonally pooled test (JJA, about 280 cases per county). With a single date, calibration lowers correlation by Week 1 -0.01, Week 2 -0.04, Week 3-4 -0.10, Week 5-6 -0.14; with pooling the change is about zero (Week 1 +0.005, Week 2 +0.017, Week 3-4 +0.032, Week 5-6 +0.046). Blue counties gain from pooling. Pooled scores are also far more precise (±0.07 vs ±0.32), so they are the values to report.

4. Resolution caveat

Calibration is county-specific, but the dynamical signal comes from the ~1.5 deg S2S grid. County differences mostly reflect county-specific ERA5-Land climatology.

6. Method notes and limitations

  • Empirical quantile mapping per county, period and pool; ERA5-Land is treated as truth.
  • sm20 from ERA5-Land layers uses 7/13 cm layer weights.
  • The current forecast is calibrated with init dates within +/-21 days of the forecast date, so the P20 threshold respects the time of year.
  • Validation holds out whole season-years. Init dates a week apart are strongly correlated, so the effective sample size is smaller than the number of rows.
  • Skill is measured against ERA5-Land, not in-situ observations. Probabilities are not verified with Brier score or reliability diagrams here.
